pages.contents: One portrait page with Supplementary Fig. 1, a love plot (line plot with markers) of absolute standardized mean differences (x axis 0 to 0.4, dashed vertical reference lines near 0.1 and 0.2) for nine matching covariates on the y axis: circumferential extent of the resection, directional distribution, location, age, tumor size, macroscopic finding, sex, histopathology, ulcer; two series, After_PSM (blue triangles, all small, roughly 0.05 to 0.15) and Before_PSM (red circles, up to about 0.4). Caption states it is a love plot before and after propensity score matching (PSM). Footer shows the journal website.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Cohort-level statistical balance diagnostic for the propensity score matching; aggregate, not individual patient history, results or measurements. No patient-level clinical facts are generated and no patient is identified.
limitations: Plotted point values are visual estimates only and are not transcribed as data; no rights exception notice is printed on the page, which does not establish blanket asset licensing.
Document inspection is an AI source review, not physician adjudication or a measurement of clinical accuracy.
